note: BLANK-SLATE page (Nougat emitted only a [MISSING_PAGE] marker). This page was previously pushed with garbage: the old Step 23 submission used the raw PDF text layer as ground truth for this page, which was itself badly corrupted OCR (e.g. stray fragments like 'U. ox DX ^ Rm API' where real digits should be). Discarded entirely and re-transcribed from the actual scan image (own vision). Dense 51-row/16-significant-digit numeric table -- structural headers + sampled rows at every 0.5 degrees (11 of 51 rows), not transcribed exhaustively, per the as_p0242/as_p0243/Step-20 dense-table convention. Spot-checked against known values (sin 35 deg = 0.573576..., cos 35 deg = 0.819152...) to confirm the transcription is correct, unlike the discarded prior draft.
